comparison.objective: Candidate separates two classes of loose production bodies through a screen; pr-1930 removes and replaces two thin shelf-edge price tickets.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual screen handling, controlled agitation, and simultaneous pass/retain behavior; pr-1930 requires opening a sprung strip, extracting and inserting thin cards, correct assignment, and avoiding nearby cans. Shared bimanual coordination is generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades mass recovery and complete washer retention before support replacement and release; pr-1930 awards per-ticket removal and correct insertion, requires the untouched ticket to remain seated, hands withdrawn, and a long stable dwell, with can tipping as permanent zero. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Thin-card extraction/insertion under a sprung cover is a different dexterous ability from physical size separation through a sieve.
